claims.text: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: Spears (ankle) and Tony Pollard (foot) will both practice Thursday, per head coach Robert Saleh, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: The Titans placed Slater (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.text: The Titans placed Carmona (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.text: The Titans signed Carter off their practice squad to their 53-man roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: Flott (quadriceps) is active for Sunday's game against the Giants, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

claims.author: John Keim
claims.text: Daniels (elbow) remained limited at practice Thursday, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

claims.author: Tashan Reed
claims.text: White (shoulder) isn't practicing again Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

claims.author: Ben Standig
claims.text: Butler is recovering from a concussion ahead of the Commanders' matchup in London against the Colts in Week 4, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

claims.author: Zach Selby
claims.text: Ekeler signed a one-year contract with the Commanders on Tuesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.
